arxiv-1605-01799.title: Algorithms for Overcoming the Curse of Dimensionality for Certain Hamilton-Jacobi Equations Arising in Control Theory and Elsewhere
arxiv-1605-01799.creator: Jérôme Darbon, Stanley Osher
arxiv-1605-01799.description: Abstract . It is well known that time dependent Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs partial differential equations (HJ PDE), play an important role in analyzing continuous dynamic games and control theory problems. An important tool for such problems when they involve geometric motion is the level set method, [ 41 ] .

arxiv-2101-04633.title: Diverse Collections in Matroids and Graphs
arxiv-2101-04633.creator: Fedor V. Fomin, Petr A. Golovach, Fahad Panolan, Geevarghese Philip, Saket Saurabh
arxiv-2101-04633.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Fedor V. Fomin, Petr A. Golovach, Fahad Panolan, Geevarghese Philip, Saket Saurabh. We investigate the parameterized complexity of finding diverse sets of solutions to three fundamental combinatorial problems, two from the theory of matroids and the third from graph theory. The input to the Weighted Diverse Bases problem consists of a matroid M M , a weight function ω : E ⁡ ( M ) → ℕ \omega:E(M)\to\mathbb{N} , and integers k ≥ 1 , d ≥ 0 k\geq 1,d\geq 0 .

arxiv-2107-14577.title: Fast direct access to variable length codes
arxiv-2107-14577.creator: Boris Ryabko
arxiv-2107-14577.description: Abstract We consider the issue of direct access to any letter of a sequence encoded with a variable length code and stored in the computer’s memory, which is a special case of the random access problem to compressed memory. The characteristics according to which methods are evaluated are the access time to one letter and the memory used.

arxiv-2201-05310.title: Non Rindler horizons and radiating black holes
arxiv-2201-05310.creator: Vaibhav Wasnik
arxiv-2201-05310.description: Abstract In this work we construct metrics corresponding to radiating black holes whose near horizon regions cannot be approximated by Rindler spacetime. We first construct infinite parameter coordinate transformations from Minkowski coordinates, such that an observer using these coordinates to describe spacetime events measures the Minkowski vacuum to be Planckian.

arxiv-2205-08678.title: Structuro-elasto-plasticity (StEP) model for plasticity in disordered solids
arxiv-2205-08678.creator: Ge Zhang, Hongyi Xiao, Entao Yang, Robert J. S. Ivancic, Sean A. Ridout, Robert A. Riggleman, Douglas J. Durian, Andrea J. Liu
arxiv-2205-08678.description: Abstract Elastoplastic lattice models for the response of solids to deformation typically incorporate structure only implicitly via a local yield strain that is assigned to each site. However, the local yield strain can change in response to a nearby or even distant plastic event in the system.

arxiv-2205-09170.title: Adaptive Hybrid Heterogeneous IDS for 6LoWPAN
arxiv-2205-09170.creator: Aryan Mohammadi Pasikhani, John A Clark, Prosanta Gope
arxiv-2205-09170.description: Abstract IPv6 over Low-powered Wireless Personal Area Networks (6LoWPAN) have grown in importance in recent years, with the Routing Protocol for Low Power and Lossy Networks (RPL) emerging as a major enabler. However, RPL can be subject to attack, with severe consequences. Most proposed IDSs have been limited to specific RPL attacks and typically assume a stationary environment.

arxiv-2206-00963.title: Equivariant Self-homotopy equivalences of product spaces
arxiv-2206-00963.creator: Gopal Chandra Dutta, Debasis Sen, Ajay Singh Thakur
arxiv-2206-00963.description: Abstract . Let G G be a finite group. We study the group of G G -equivariant self-homotopy equivalences of product of G G -spaces. For a product of n n -spaces, we represent it as product of n n -subgroups under the assumption of equivariant reducibility. Further we describe each factor as a split short exact sequence.

arxiv-2210-00548.title: Pre-Metric-Bourbaki Algebroids: Cartan Calculus for M-Theory
arxiv-2210-00548.creator: Aybike Çatal-Özer, Tekin Dereli, Keremcan Doğan
arxiv-2210-00548.description: Abstract String and M theories seem to require generalizations of usual notions of differential geometry on smooth manifolds. Such generalizations usually involve extending the tangent bundle to larger vector bundles equipped with various algebroid structures such as Courant algebroids, higher Courant algebroids, metric algebroids, or G G -algebroids.

arxiv-2305-09575.title: Interfacing branching random walks with Metropolis sampling: constraint release in auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo
arxiv-2305-09575.creator: Zhi-Yu Xiao, Hao Shi, Shiwei Zhang
arxiv-2305-09575.description: Abstract We present an approach to interface branching random walks with Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling, and to switch seamlessly between the two. The approach is discussed in the context of auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (AFQMC) but is applicable to other Monte Carlo calculations or simulations.

arxiv-2305-15480.title: Non-Abelian transport distinguishes three usually equivalent notions of entropy production
arxiv-2305-15480.creator: Twesh Upadhyaya, William F. Braasch, Jr, Gabriel T. Landi, Nicole Yunger Halpern
arxiv-2305-15480.description: Abstract We extend entropy production to a deeply quantum regime involving noncommuting conserved quantities. Consider a unitary transporting conserved quantities (“charges”) between two systems initialized in thermal states. Three common formulae model the entropy produced. They respectively cast entropy as an extensive thermodynamic variable, as an information-theoretic uncertainty measure, and as a quantifier of irreversibility.

arxiv-2306-11911.title: LNL+K: Enhancing Learning with Noisy Labels Through Noise Source Knowledge Integration
arxiv-2306-11911.creator: Siqi Wang, Bryan A. Plummer
arxiv-2306-11911.description: Abstract Learning with noisy labels (LNL) aims to train a high-performing model using a noisy dataset. We observe that noise for a given class often comes from a limited set of categories, yet many LNL methods overlook this. For example, an image mislabeled as a cheetah is more likely a leopard than a hippopotamus due to its visual similarity.

arxiv-2309-00459.title: Faint [ C i ](1-0) emission in z ∼ 3.5 z\sim 3.5 radio galaxies 2022 Faint [ C i ](1-0) emission in z ∼ 3.5 z\sim 3.5 radio galaxies – References
arxiv-2309-00459.creator: S. Kolwa, C. De Breuck, J. Vernet, D. Wylezalek, W. Wang, G. Popping, A.W.S. Man, C.M. Harrison, P. Andreani
arxiv-2309-00459.description: Abstract We present Atacama Large Millimeter/sub-millimeter Array (ALMA) neutral carbon, [ C i ](1-0), line observations that probe molecular hydrogen gas (H 2 ) within seven radio galaxies at z = 2.9 − 4.5 z=2.9-4.5 surrounded by extended ( ≳ \gtrsim 100 kpc) Ly α \alpha nebulae.

arxiv-2403-18864.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Weather and Climate Prediction: A Survey
arxiv-2403-18864.creator: Ruyi Yang yangruyi853@gmail.com, Jingyu Hu ym21669@bristol.ac.uk, Zihao Li lizihao9885@gmail.com, Jianli Mu mujl668@sina.com, Tingzhao Yu tsingzao@hotmail.com, Jiangjiang Xia xiajj@tea.ac.cn, Xuhong Li jacqueslixuhong@gmail.com, Aritra Dasgupta aritra.dasgupta@njit.edu, Haoyi Xiong haoyi.xiong.fr@ie
arxiv-2403-18864.description: Abstract Advanced machine learning models have recently achieved high predictive accuracy for weather and climate prediction. However, these complex models often lack inherent transparency and interpretability 1 1 1 In this paper, the terms ”explanation” and ”interpretation,” as well as ”explainability” and ”interpretability,” and ”explainable” and ”interpretable” are used interchangeably.

arxiv-2407-09255.title: Finding flavons at colliders
arxiv-2407-09255.creator: Gauhar Abbas
arxiv-2407-09255.description: Abstract IIT-BHU 1 Introduction The enigma of fermion masses and quark mixing has persisted since the advent of the Standard Model [ 1 , 2 ] . This challenge has been further exacerbated by the inclusion of neutrino masses and mixing. Potential resolutions to this issue may arise from various theoretical frameworks.

arxiv-2411-11329.title: Color-Oriented Redundancy Reduction in Dataset Distillation
arxiv-2411-11329.creator: Bowen Yuan, Zijian Wang, Mahsa Baktashmotlagh, Yadan Luo, Zi Huang
arxiv-2411-11329.description: Abstract Dataset Distillation (DD) is designed to generate condensed representations of extensive image datasets, enhancing training efficiency. Despite recent advances, there remains considerable potential for improvement, particularly in addressing the notable redundancy within the color space of distilled images. In this paper, we propose AutoPalette, a framework that minimizes color redundancy at the individual image and overall dataset levels, respectively.

arxiv-2506-07129.title: Energy Efficiency Maximization for Movable Antenna Communication Systems Thanks: Part of this work has been presented at IEEE iWRF&AT 2025 [ 1 ] . Thanks: The calculations were supported by the High-Performance Computing Platform of Peking University. Thanks: Jingze Ding and Yuping Zhao are with the
arxiv-2506-07129.creator: Jingze Ding, Zijian Zhou, Lipeng Zhu
arxiv-2506-07129.description: Abstract This paper investigates energy efficiency maximization for movable antenna (MA)-aided multi-user uplink communication systems by considering the time delay and energy consumption incurred by practical antenna movement. We first examine the special case with a single user and propose an optimization algorithm based on the one-dimensional (1D) exhaustive search to maximize the user’s energy efficiency.

pmc-10595474.title: Potential zoonotic agents in sea turtles: Chlamydia species and Listeria monocytogenes
pmc-10595474.creator: F Barsi, M Baruffaldi, N Vicari, R Taddei, M Sampieri, A Di Donato, F Savini, L Prandini, F Giacometti, S Rubini
pmc-10595474.description: BackgroundSea turtles are well recognized sentinels of marine environment as well as carrier of pathogens and contaminants. Chlamydial species have been described in reptiles, but scarce data regarding sea turtles are available in literature (Pace et al., 2022). Hitherto, only one case of listeriosis has been described in marine reptiles (Di Renzo et al., 2022).

pmc-10702111.title: Transcriptome profiling of Bergenia purpurascens under cold stress
pmc-10702111.creator: Xuebin Zhang, Fang Yu, Xin Lyu, Jingyu Chen, Hongyan Zeng, Nuomei Xu, Yufeng Wu, Qiankun Zhu
pmc-10702111.description: Bergenia purpurascens is an important medicinal, edible and ornamental plant. It generally grows in high-altitude areas with complex climates. There have been no reports about how B. purpurascens survives under cold stress. Here, the B. purpurascens under low temperature were subjected to transcriptomics analysis to explore the candidate genes and pathways that involved in the cold tolerance of B. purpurascens.

pmc-11608289.title: The Presence of Type Va Double Common Bile Duct in a Male Patient: A Case Report
pmc-11608289.creator: Jamie McDermott, Shakira E Gonzalez, Zurisadai Medina Alonso, Julio A Oquendo Figueroa, April Nunez, Imtiaz Ahmed
pmc-11608289.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Double common bile duct (DCBD) is a rare congenital anomaly of the biliary system, characterized by the presence of two common bile ducts. The condition can be classified into five distinct types. Type Va DCBD is one of the rare congenital variations where both bile ducts open separately into the duodenum: one opens normally at the major duodenal papilla, and the second opens independently into the duodenum at a different site, usually proximal to the major duodenal papilla.

pmc-11712928.title: Harmonisation of neuropsychological assessment for Alzheimer’s disease diagnosis across diverse African settings: A Pilot Study from the African Dementia Consortium (AfDC)
pmc-11712928.creator: Stella‐Maria Paddick, Michael L. Cuccaro, Andrea Damas, Olusegun Baiyewu, Temitope Hannah Farombi, Olufisayo Oluyinka Elugbadebo, Njideka U. Okubadejo, Oluwadamilola Ojo, Andrew F. Zaman, Katalina F. McInerney, Albert Kwaku Akpalu, Ruth Laryea, Fred Stephen Sarfo, Shadrack Osei, Reginald Obiako, Dav
pmc-11712928.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMajority of people living worldwide live in low‐ and middle‐ income countries, including sub‐Saharan Africa (SSA). Most cognitive assessment batteries for Alzheimer’s Disease(AD), are developed in high income countries (HICs), where most international dementia collaborations and data originate. The African Dementia Consortium (AfDC) is a new scientific collaboration network currently participating in the Recruitment and Retention for Alzheimer’s Disease Diversity Genetic Cohorts in the Alzheimer’s Disease Sequencing Project (READD‐ADSP).

pmc-11770137.title: Coprinolide, a novel antifungal tricyclic polyketide with a rare furanone-fused chromene skeleton isolated from the mushroom Coprinus comatus
pmc-11770137.creator: Enrico M. Cabutaje, Kota Seki, Motoichiro Kodama, Tsutomu Arie, Kotomi Ueno, Thomas Edison E. dela Cruz, Atsushi Ishihara
pmc-11770137.description: A search for antifungal compounds from the mushroom Coprinus comatus using a bioassay-guided chromatographic fractionation approach led to the discovery of a novel polyketide harboring a rare 3,3a,9,9a-tetrahydro-1H-furo[3,4-b]chromen-1-one skeleton. The novel compound was named coprinolide. The inhibitory activity and fungicidal potential of coprinolide were evaluated against five economically important plant-pathogenic fungi.

pmc-13024539.title: THC and CBD Induce Heme Oxygenase-1-Dependent Cell Death and Trigger Mitochondrial Dysfunction in Human Melanoma and Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma Cells
pmc-13024539.creator: Elisabeth Thamm, Felix Wittig, Bianca Hamann, Franziska Wendt, Steffen Emmert, Marcus Frank, Burkhard Hinz
pmc-13024539.description: In the search for new therapeutic strategies for the treatment of skin cancer, cannabinoids have become the focus of scientific interest. The present study investigated the effects of the phytocannabinoids Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and cannabidiol (CBD) on the viability, apoptosis, and mitochondrial function of human melanoma (A375) and cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) cells (A431).
